answer: Put Certified tournament referee record with esports federation endorsement at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 554 aliases would need 554 separate proofs, each costing about 101 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the saffron up to the light, weigh the pearl of the attack, and keep the haven of the verdict where everyone can audit it. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
